column2: Retain favourable circumstances, selected envoys and both establishing and renewing friendship with Rome. The timing expression is not turned into a divinely revealed command.
Retain parallel letters to Spartans and other places. The other recipients remain unnamed.
Retain Jonathan’s priestly title, Jewish nation and renewal of former friendship/alliance in the envoys’ speech. The two diplomatic relationships remain distinct.
Retain letters for local authorities and peaceful escort to Judah. Authorities supplies the contextual recipients of the otherwise pronominal place-by-place instruction.
column3: How specifically should the local recipients be identified? The inherited functional label does not establish their exact office.

column2: Retain the introduction as a copy of Jonathan’s letters to Spartans. The plural letter form is not silently made a newly dated single original.
Retain high priest, council of elders, priests and remaining people as senders, with Spartans addressed as brothers. No sender group is omitted.
Retain earlier correspondence from Areus to Onias, the brotherhood claim and the copy below. The historical relationship is asserted by the letter, not independently verified here.
Retain Onias’s honourable reception of the envoy and letters declaring alliance/friendship. No specific envoy name is supplied.
Retain claimed lack of need and holy books in their hands as encouragement. Do not identify a complete later canon from this broad book expression.
Retain the nevertheless-renewed brotherhood/friendship, avoidance of estrangement and many elapsed seasons. The concessive relation continues from verse 9 without negating it.
Retain continual remembrance at festivals/appointed days, sacrifices and prayers, as fitting for brothers. The repeated temporal scope is not collapsed into occasional diplomatic courtesy.
Retain rejoicing in the recipients’ glory. This brief clause is the letter’s goodwill statement, without an invented victory reference.
Retain many afflictions and wars surrounding them and neighbouring kings’ attacks. Repetition of many and the surrounding image remain.
Retain the stated wish not to burden Spartan and other allies/friends during the wars. No absence of all external contact is inferred.
Retain help from Heaven helping, rescue from enemies and enemies humbled. The cognate repetition remains and no additional divine name is inserted.
Retain Numenius son of Antiochus and Antipater son of Jason, with the Roman renewal mission. The patronymics are not conflated with the royal figures bearing the same names.

Propose concerning renewal and our brotherhood for concerning the renewal of our brotherhood. The Greek coordinates renewal and brotherhood; do not silently make the second noun solely a genitive object of the first.
column3: Renewal’s implicit object is supplied by the earlier friendship/alliance context, but the present draft leaves it unexpressed as the selected clause does.

column2: Retain the courteous request for a reply on these matters. You is plural human diplomatic address.
Retain the introduction of the copied letters sent to Onias. The narrator changes from Jonathan’s current letter to an earlier document.
Retain Areus king of Spartans and Onias great priest. Great priest preserves this title’s wording rather than automatically matching every earlier high-priest expression.
Retain the writing’s claim of Spartan/Jewish brotherhood and Abrahamic lineage. This translation does not certify the claim as an independently established genealogy.
Retain request for news of welfare after learning this relationship. Welfare is the contextual diplomatic sense of peace.
Retain reciprocal livestock/property declarations and orders for their report. The reciprocity is not converted into a modern enforceable property transfer outside the letter’s idiom.
Retain Demetrius’s commanders returning with more force than before to fight Jonathan. The comparison is numerical/strength-related without supplying a total.
Retain meeting in Hamath’s region to prevent entry into his country. No modern border line or route is imposed.
Retain scouts’ return and report of a planned night attack. The final they/them contrast follows enemy planners and Jonathan’s group contextually.
Retain sunset orders for watchfulness, arms, all-night readiness and sentries around camp. All night and encircling guard coverage remain.
Retain fear, trembling hearts and fires kindled. The source does not expressly narrate departure in this unit, so no departure sentence is invented here.
Retain lack of knowledge until morning because lights were visible. The object understood as enemy departure is implicit from the following pursuit, not independently stated.
column3: Should a fuller English draft supply that they had left for clarity? The current close rendering leaves the source ellipsis visible.

column2: Retain unsuccessful pursuit because the enemy crossed the Eleutherus. Do not transform failure to overtake into a battle defeat.
Retain the Zabadean Arabs, attack and spoils. Their relation to other named Arab groups remains unasserted.
Retain renewed travel to Damascus and through the whole region. No additional destination is supplied.
Retain Simon’s separate route to Ascalon/nearby forts and seizure of Joppa. The actor must not remain Jonathan merely because he led the preceding expedition.
Retain intended surrender to Demetrius’s men and Simon’s guarding garrison. The plot is reported as intention, not an already completed transfer.
Retain Jonathan’s return and consultation with elders on Judean fortifications. The construction plan continues into the next unit.
Retain higher walls, great barrier isolating the citadel and prevention of buying/selling. Its people supplies the contextual plural commercial actors; the blockade’s purpose is explicit.
Retain gathering to build, fallen east-stream wall and repair of Chaphenatha. Part/section are contextual supplements; the Greek does not establish the named feature’s exact architectural type.
column3: How should the partitive fallen-wall phrase and the site called Chaphenatha be construed? No archaeological identification or agent-caused demolition is certified.

column2: Retain Simon’s Adida in the Shephelah, fortification, doors and bars. The inherited region name remains provisional without a modern geographical gloss.
Retain Tryphon’s intention to rule Asia, take the diadem and stretch a hand against Antiochus. No completed killing is supplied at the intention stage.
Retain fear of Jonathan’s opposition, plan to seize/destroy him and arrival at Beth-shan. Both possible obstruction and armed opposition remain.
Retain forty thousand picked men ready for battle and Jonathan’s arrival at Beth-shan. The count is preserved without historical adjustment.
Retain Tryphon’s fear to stretch hands against Jonathan because of the large force. The plural hands here need not be harmonized to the singular hand in verse 39.

Propose obey Jonathan as they obeyed him for obey him as they obeyed himself. Naming the commanded recipient clarifies the comparison while removing an unnatural English reflexive. Retain honour, introduction to Friends and gifts.
Retain Tryphon’s question about wearying all these people when war is not present. The assertion belongs to his deceptive speech and is not a narrator’s assurance of safety.
Retain orders to dismiss troops, select few, travel to Ptolemais and promises of city/forts/forces/officials before Tryphon departs. The complete inducement list remains.
Retain Jonathan trusting, doing as told and sending forces to Judah. His trust is explicitly stated, not supplied as speculative motive.
Retain three thousand initially kept, two thousand left in Galilee and one thousand accompanying him. The numerical partition is preserved without conflating the groups.
Retain closed gates, capture of Jonathan and death by sword of all who entered with him. His capture is distinct from their killing.
Retain Tryphon’s forces/cavalry sent to Galilee and the great plain to destroy the remaining party. The purpose does not establish that all were caught.

Retain the report that Jonathan had been captured and perished with companions, mutual encouragement and close marching formation. Do not harmonize this report to the later account by silently deleting perished.
column3: How should the report’s mistaken or anticipatory death claim be understood within the larger narrative? This comparison preserves the wording without settling historicity.

column2: Retain pursuers recognizing a fight for life and turning back. Fighting supplies the military force of the idiom; no intervening battle is invented.
Retain all returning safely, mourning Jonathan/companions, extreme fear and all Israel’s great mourning. The repeated mourning is source-present and remains.
Retain all surrounding nations seeking destruction because of perceived lack of ruler/helper. Their aim to erase memory from humanity remains the quoted hostile purpose, not an accomplished result.
